what: The lane key names workspace, branch, lane record and agent names: gh<N> for GitHub, the lowercased Linear key (eng-123) for Linear; a recipe's N is the parent ticket as the tracker writes it; a role's skills line may name {tracker}, which pi-role resolves from .octo-feather.toml. Adds acceptance-supervise-layout-linear.
why: Owner ruling (2026-10-22, issue #82): the kit works with Linear directly so it can run on a Linear-first repository; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says 'tab supervisor in workspace gh<N>' (role-supervisor); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target.
